text:
ida_ops: Heads-up — scheduling a maintenance window for rack r34 in us-east1 (03/25 02:00-03:30 UTC). Root cause: NIC microcode from last week left r34 partially islanded (ToR->BMC link flaps). Plan is a rolling host restart + ToR firmware patch and KV cache warm-up. Expect ~6 nodes (12 GPUs) offline at any one time. :warning:
mike_oncall: How much user impact? Any Hosted API SLO risk?
ida_ops: Minimal if we follow the plan. Region has ~24% free GPU headroom right now. We'll move low-priority batches and spot tenants off before cordon, and route traffic to eu-west1 fallback for heavy latency-sensitive requests. No SLA breach expected for hosted, but some Dedicated tenants may see slight throughput degradation if they were pinned to r34; we'll put a temporary admission-control rate cap.
sam_sre: Suggest stagger: cordon 1 node every 6m, reboot, sanity checks (ssh + nvml + kernel logs), then uncordon. Monitor p95 token latency and queue depth. If p95 > target for two consecutive checks, pause. Also add a 10m warmup after each node to let prefix cache rebuild.
ida_ops: Agreed. Rough sequence:
```
for node in r34-node{01..06}; do
  kubectl cordon $node
  kubectl drain $node --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=15m
  ssh $node sudo systemctl restart nvpeer-gpu && sudo reboot
  sleep 360
  # post-reboot checks
  ssh $node 'nvidia-smi || dmesg | tail -n50'
  kubectl uncordon $node
 done
```
(we'll actually run with orchestration so this is the human-readable sequence)
raj_infra: Network note — ToR firmware patch requires BGP session reset with spine; expect 20–45s egress blackhole per ToR during rewrite. Need netteam on-call to trigger and watch MRT. Opening ENGNET ticket: https://issue/ENGNET-9981. Can we apply ToR patch after node reboots to avoid simultaneous host+ToR churn?
ida_ops: Good call. Reorder: do host reboots first (one node at time), allow KV/prefix cache warmup, then apply ToR patch during lower-traffic slice at +40m mark. Netteam to confirm maintenance window.
anna_product: We should send a short customer comm to Dedicated customers pinned to us-east1. Draft: "Planned maintenance in us-east1 on 2026-03-25 02:00-03:30 UTC affecting a small subset of hardware. Workloads will be migrated; some Dedicated tenants may see transient throughput reduction. No expected downtime for Hosted API. Contact support if you have fixed pinning." Can ops tweak wording?
mike_oncall: Add hotline for any immediate SLA concerns and reference to status.redwood.ai. Also add suggested mitigation: customers can temporarily pin to eu-west1 via Console — include steps link.
ida_ops: Will post comm 24h prior and again 1h prior. Assigning owners: ida_ops (ops lead), raj_infra (network lead), sam_sre (safety checks), anna_product (customer comm), mike_oncall (oncall).
deploy-bot: preflight-check: host-health=ok; regional-headroom=24%; pending-network-approval=true
sam_sre: Emergency rollback plan: if we detect persistent NVML errors or >5% task eviction, abort remaining reboots and start controlled backfill to eu-west1 and apac1. Keep a 2-node hot spare in us-east1 (r37) to receive immediate failover.
ida_ops: Cost note: cross-region shift of warm caches estimated ~$320 for the window (egress + transient instances). Finance ok with small commit; will log in ops-costs.
raj_infra: Netteam confirmed ENGNET-9981; ToR patching scheduled to start at 03:00 UTC with a single ToR at a time, 10m spacing between ToRs. They'll run `show bgp summary` and sanity-check routes.
anna_product: ACK — I'll prepare the comm and coordinate with support to enable priority handling for any Dedicated tickets.
mike_oncall: I'll be onpager for the window. If anything looks off, ping @mike_oncall and we can pause. :thumbsup:
ida_ops: Final check list for runbook (short): 1) migrate spot jobs 2) cordon+drain node 3) reboot & nvml check 4) warm cache 10m 5) uncordon 6) repeat 7) ToR patch at +40m 8) verify BGP routes 9) final cluster health report. I'll paste full runbook to #incidents after this.
sam_sre: I'll wire up alerting thresholds to post to this thread and to the oncall channel for p95 token latency, queue depth, and GPU error rates.
ida_ops: Thanks team — proceeding to notify customers and ops channels. Please react with :eyes: when you read this and :white_check_mark: when you're on the roster for the window.
